items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, one of Johnny's records on OK came out, and Tom Brown and some of them were on that. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, the first record I actually made never did come out. It was made in Richmond, Indiana, with Johnny Bisonoff, his band. Oh, yeah. But they never did release those records. It was just a little bit after the Wolverines made their records.
Yeah, one of Johnny's records on OK came out, and Tom Brown and some of them were on that.
